title: Exit bookkeeping and teardown confirmation

options.name: Keep current behaviour
options.risk: A partial tier can be re-sold after a crash, landed repriced sells have no row, sold positions resume as failed, and one balance read at one confirmation decides an irreversible teardown.

options.name: Persist tier completion and sell rows from chain truth (tx hash, receipt) before slow steps; wrap teardown in a transaction; re-check balance after a few blocks before teardown
options.behavior_impact: Records match the chain after a crash; no double tier sells.

recommendation: crash-safe-records (the tier re-sell part in Phase 24, the rest in Phase 29).
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). Capital-relevant, but the linked findings are S2 or lower, so the default is safe to rest on until then.
behavior_impact: Decides how exit state survives crashes and reorgs.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
